text: dsh-opencode-go-quota 是面向 DSH Web 侧边栏的额度监控插件。它在侧边栏页脚加入徽标和悬停卡片，由 Host 端独立轮询 OpenCode Go 的 5 小时、周、月用量，以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。徽标展示当前最紧的用量窗口或余额，卡片可查看进度、重置时间和数据状态，并能手动刷新、切换额度来源。轮询失败时保留上次成功数据并退避重试。适合希望在 DSH 内快速查看额度的用户；需要在 DSH 凭证服务配置对应 provider 的 API key。

dsh-opencode-go-quota adds a quota badge and hover card to the DSH sidebar. It polls OpenCode Go and DeepSeek, showing usage, reset times, and status. Users can switch providers and refresh. Failed polls keep prior data and retry later. Configure the provider key in DSH credentials.
想在 DSH 侧边栏随时看 OpenCode Go 额度。
有没有办法同时查看模型额度和 DeepSeek 账户余额？
我想知道五小时、每周和每月额度哪个最紧。
让 DSH 自动定时刷新上游的用量信息。
额度接口暂时失败时，希望还能看到上次的数据。
能不能在悬停卡片里查看用量和重置时间？
Show my OpenCode Go quota in the DSH sidebar.
I want to check my DeepSeek balance without leaving DSH.
dsh-opencode-go-quota 的功能「查看 OpenCode Go 用量」：显示滚动五小时、每周和每月窗口的使用百分比、状态及重置时间。Host 定时请求上游，客户端在侧边栏徽标和卡片中呈现。
dsh-opencode-go-quota 的功能「查看 DeepSeek 余额」：从 DeepSeek 余额接口读取账户余额并选择可读金额；若余额不可用，会附带余额不足状态。结果显示在额度来源对应的侧边栏卡片中。
dsh-opencode-go-quota 的功能「侧边栏额度徽标和详情卡」：在侧边栏页脚展示额度来源徽标；悬停查看各窗口进度、重置信息和数据状态，并可手动刷新或切换 provider。
dsh-opencode-go-quota 的功能「失败后保留数据并退避」：上游请求失败时保留最近一次成功的窗口或余额数据并标记过期，连续失败后逐步延长轮询间隔；用户仍可手动刷新。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 特性：- **环内嵌品牌字** —— 环同时承担进度指示与品牌标识（`Go` / `DS`），不占用额外横向空间
- **只报最紧的窗口** —— 同一家有多个窗口时，显示最接近触顶的那个
- **窗口数量由上游决定** —— 不写死「三个窗口」，按套餐给窗口的来源也能正确展示
- **失败不丢数据** —— 上游不可用时保留上一次成功的数据并标记为过期
- **凭证复用** —— 直接读取模型设置里已配置的 API key，无需另填一份
- **中英双语** —— 跟随 DSH 的语言设置即时切换
- **失败退避** —— 连续失败时按指数放大轮询间隔
- **故障隔离** —— 每个额度源各自一个调度器，一家挂了不影响别家的节奏与数据

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 额度源：插件内置两个适配器，各自独立取数、独立退避：

| ID | 名称 | 凭证来源 | 额度形态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go | DSH 凭证 `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY`（与模型设置共用） | 5 小时 / 周 / 月三个百分比窗口 |
| `deepseek` | DeepSeek | DSH 凭证 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | 账户余额（无窗口） |

删掉 `providers:` 下某一行即关掉那一家；写 `enabled: false` 可临时停用而保留配置。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · OpenCode Go：额度由三个**平级**窗口组成，任一打满即触发限流：

| 窗口 | 上游字段 | 额度 | 重置规则 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 小时 | `rolling` | 月度额度的 20% | 滚动窗口：最后一次用量时间 + 5 小时 |
| 周 | `weekly` | 月度额度的 50% | 自然周边界 |
| 月 | `monthly` | 月度额度的 100% | 订阅日锚定的账单月 |

插件始终显示**最接近上限的那个窗口**。由于三者平级，仅显示月度窗口会在 5 小时窗口接近打满时给出过于乐观的信号。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 侧边栏徽标：```
(Go) ................ 月 46%
 ↑                     ↑
 环：进度 + 品牌        最紧窗口的已用百分比
```

- **弧长**为最紧窗口的已用百分比
- **配色**随阈值变化：低于 80% 为绿色，80% 起为琥珀色，95% 起为红色
- **窗口标识**为当前最紧的窗口（中文 `5h` / `周` / `月`）
- **百分比**整数不带小数点，有小数才保留一位（`6.5%`）
- 侧边栏折叠时仅显示环，环内的品牌字保证它仍可辨识
- 悬停时整行显示底色，与侧边栏其他条目一致
- 行高、内边距、圆角与下方账号行取同一组数字，环与账号头像左对齐

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 多额度源：每家一页，左右滑动切换；徽标只报当前页那一家的最紧窗口，不做跨家聚合——
两家各自的额度是两笔独立预算，合并成一个数字会让人误以为是同一份额度。
页码圆点按各自状态着色，所以停在 A 页时 B 页变红也一眼看得见。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 悬停卡片：鼠标划过展开，显示各窗口的进度条、重置倒计时与数据新鲜度。

- 移出后留有 260 毫秒宽限期，便于指针移入卡片
- 点击徽标或在卡片内按下会固定卡片，之后可自由选中文字、点击刷新
- `Esc`、点击外部或再次点击徽标均可关闭
- 滚动窗口（`activity_triggered`）没有确定重置时刻时显示「按使用滚动重置」

卡片右上角显示数据状态：

| 状态 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 正常 | 最近一次拉取成功，无窗口被限流 |
| 已限流 | 有窗口报告 `status === 'rate-limited'` |
| 数据过期 | 拉取失败，展示的是上一次成功的数据 |
| 不可用 | 拉取失败且无可用数据 |

┌─ 客户端半边 (lib/client.js) ─────────────────────────────┐
│  sidebar.footer.action 槽位 → 徽标 + 悬停卡片            │

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 实现说明：**Host 半边不依赖任何 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包。**
插件安装在 profile 目录下，该处无法解析 DSH 的内部包。而 `CredentialRef` 与服务键在运行时均为普通字符串（品牌标注仅存在于类型层），因此直接传入 `'OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY'` 即可。

**数据通过同源 HTTP 路由传递，而非 Remote 命名空间。**
`dsh-api-remotes` 的客户端命名空间集是构建期的固定导入列表，插件无法扩展（见 `dsh-api-remotes/README.md:75-76`）。因此插件通过 `ctx.webServer.register()` 注册一条 exact 路由，并在处理函数中调用 `ctx.connection.admit(req)` 以复用应用自身的请求信任策略，不自行实现鉴权。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 常见问题：**徽标显示的是月 46%，为什么不是 5 小时的数字？**
徽标显示的是当前最接近上限的窗口。当 5 小时窗口的百分比超过月度窗口时，标识会自动切换为 `5h`。

**为什么没有「今日用量」？**
上游未提供日窗口。在本地推算需要持续累计轮询差值，且仅在 DSH 运行期间有效，数据不完整，因此未实现。

**能查看按模型拆分的明细吗？**
不能。控制台页面提供该明细，但通过登录会话而非 API key 获取，插件无法访问。本插件展示三个窗口的聚合百分比。

**数据多久更新一次？**
Host 每 5 分钟向上游拉取一次（可通过 `pollIntervalSec` 调整），客户端每 30 秒读取一次本地快照。刚启动、还没有任何数据时，客户端改用 1 秒间隔补读（最多 60 次），所以徽标会自己出现，不需要手动触发。悬停展开卡片时会补读一次，卡片右下角的刷新按钮会立即向上游发起请求。

**提示「凭证 OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY 未配置」？**
说明 DSH 的凭证服务中没有该名称。请检查模型设置中 opencode-go provider 的 key 是否已配置。

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · 已知限制：- OpenCode Go 的上游接口为控制台内部路由，非公开承诺的 API。因此 `baseUrl` 可配置，解析失败时降级展示而非崩溃。
- OpenCode Go 的 `percent` 为整数（服务端执行 `Math.floor`），粒度较粗。
- 仅提供中文与英文词典。locale fallback 链必须终结于 `en`，其他语言将回落到英文。
- Host 侧的原始错误文本为中文，仅在状态码未知时作为兜底展示。

A **DeepSeek Harness plugin** that shows [OpenCode Go](https://opencode.ai/docs/go/) quota usage directly in the sidebar.

One glance at the small ring in the sidebar footer shows the usage and reset time of all three windows — no need to open the console page.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Features：- **"Go" inside the ring** — the ring carries both the progress arc and the brand mark, costing no extra horizontal space
- **Reports the tightest window** — the three windows have independent caps; the badge shows whichever is closest to its limit
- **Failures never discard data** — an unavailable upstream keeps the last good reading and marks it stale
- **Credential reuse** — reads the API key already configured in your model settings; nothing to enter twice
- **Bilingual** — Chinese and English dictionaries that follow the DSH language setting live
- **Backoff on failure** — consecutive failures widen the polling interval exponentially

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Quota model：OpenCode Go quota consists of three **sibling** windows. Exhausting any one of them triggers rate limiting:

| Window | Upstream field | Allowance | Reset rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| 5 hours | `rolling` | 20% of the monthly allowance | Sliding: last usage time + 5 hours |
| Week | `weekly` | 50% of the monthly allowance | Calendar week boundary |
| Month | `monthly` | 100% of the monthly allowance | Billing month anchored to your subscribe date |

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Quota model：The plugin always shows **the window closest to its limit**. Because the three are siblings, showing only the monthly window would give an overly optimistic signal as the 5-hour window approaches its cap.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Sidebar badge：- **Arc length** is the used percent of the tightest window
- **Colour** follows the thresholds: green below 80%, amber from 80%, red from 95%
- **Window tag** names the tightest window (`5h` / `Wk` / `Mo` in English, `5h` / `周` / `月` in Chinese)
- When the sidebar is collapsed only the ring remains; the "Go" inside keeps it recognisable
- Hovering shows a row background, matching the sidebar's other entries
- Row height, padding and corner radius reuse the account row's numbers, so the ring lines up with the account avatar below it

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Hover card：Hover to expand. It shows a progress bar per window, the reset countdown, and how fresh the data is.

- A 260 ms grace period on mouse-out lets the pointer travel into the card
- Clicking the badge, or pressing anywhere inside the card, pins it — after that you can select text and click refresh freely
- `Esc`, clicking outside, or clicking the badge again closes it

Status shown at the top right:

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Hover card：| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Normal | Last fetch succeeded, no window is rate limited |
| Rate limited | Some window reports `status === 'rate-limited'` |
| Stale | Fetch failed; the last successful reading is shown |
| Unavailable | Fetch failed and no data is available |

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · How it works：```
┌─ Client half (lib/client.js) ────────────────────────────┐
│  sidebar.footer.action slot → badge + hover card         │
│  Reads the host's in-memory snapshot every 30 s          │

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Implementation notes：**The host half imports nothing from `@deepseek-ai/*`.**
The plugin is installed under the profile directory, where DSH's internal packages do not resolve. `CredentialRef` and service keys are plain strings at runtime — their branding exists only at the type level — so passing `'OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY'` directly is sufficient.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Implementation notes：**Data travels over a same-origin HTTP route rather than a Remote namespace.**
`dsh-api-remotes`' client namespace set is a fixed build-time import list that plugins cannot extend (see `dsh-api-remotes/README.md:75-76`). The plugin therefore registers an exact route with `ctx.webServer.register()` and calls `ctx.connection.admit(req)` inside the handler, reusing the application's own request-trust policy instead of implementing its own auth.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Tests：**`test/client.test.mjs`** — render test.
Provides a mock `window.__ModuleLoader__` facade, evaluates the bundle, and runs the factory with a `require` that only knows `react`. dsh-opencode-go-quota README · FAQ：**The badge shows month 46% — why not the 5-hour number?**
The badge shows whichever window is currently closest to its limit. Once the 5-hour window's percentage exceeds the monthly one, the tag switches to `5h` automatically.

**Why is there no "today's usage"?**
The upstream has no daily window. Deriving one locally would require accumulating poll deltas, and only while DSH runs — incomplete data, so it is not implemented.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · FAQ：**Can I see a per-model breakdown?**
No. The console page offers one, but it is served through a login session rather than the API key, so a plugin cannot reach it. This plugin reports the three aggregate percentages.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · FAQ：**How often does the data update?**
The host polls upstream every 5 minutes (adjustable via `pollIntervalSec`), and the client reads the local snapshot every 30 seconds. While it has no data at all — right after a start — the client retries every second instead (up to 60 times), so the badge fills itself in without any manual trigger. Hovering the card re-reads once, and the refresh button at the card's bottom right fetches upstream immediately.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · FAQ：**It says "Credential OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY is not configured"?**
DSH's credential service has no such name. Check that the opencode-go provider key is configured in your model settings.

dsh-opencode-go-quota README · Known limitations：- The upstream endpoint is an internal console route, not a promised public API. Hence the configurable `baseUrl` and the degraded display (rather than a crash) when parsing fails.
- `percent` is an integer (the server applies `Math.floor`), so the granularity is coarse.
- Only Chinese and English dictionaries ship. A locale fallback chain must terminate at `en`, so other languages fall back to English.
- The host's raw error text is written in Chinese and is only shown as a fallback for unknown state codes.
